title: bug: qa_approve and qa_reject answer nextAction moe.wait_for_task REVIEW, the in-session claim hint, but a QA seat's session is pinned to its first claim's attempt identity, so a QA CLI that follows the hint claims a second row whose get_context and verdict calls are refused ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED (QA twin of task-55a5a9f9)
description:
Held item from hunt #16 (task-151a2c54, architect-2a219562, msg-2ded7d4b). The governor filed it at 06:04Z on 2026-11-04 after re-checking it at tip 9224de15.

PROBLEM
- After a verdict, qa_approve's response sets nextAction to moe.wait_for_task for REVIEW (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaApprove.ts:299), and qa_reject does the same (qaReject.ts:459).
- The QA wrapper pins the session to the claim's attempt in pre-flight (pin_attempt_identity, scripts/moe-agent.sh ~:10357, and its ps1 twin). moe-proxy then stamps MOE_ATTEMPT_ID/GENERATION onto get_context, qa_approve and qa_reject.
- So a QA CLI that obeys the hint and claims a second REVIEW row inside the same session presents the first row's attempt identity on every call for the second row. That identity is refused ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED, and the second review is wasted.
- task-55a5a9f9 (DONE) fixed the same shape for request_replan: an END_SESSION handoff and no in-session claim hint.

FIX DIRECTION
- Mirror 55a5a9f9: after a verdict, end the session (an END_SESSION sessionHandoff, or no in-session claim nextAction), so the wrapper's next pre-flight claims and pins the next row.
- Keep every other field of the verdict response unchanged.
- Sync the `### moe.qa_approve` and `### moe.qa_reject` sections of docs/MCP_SERVER.md, and any qa.md/qa.reference.md line that tells QA to keep claiming in-session.

PLACEMENT: this waits in BACKLOG on fefce964 and 77e54ebb, both in REVIEW. Both edit qaApprove.ts and qaReject.ts. Once they land, re-anchor :299 and :459 at the tip. The governor promotes the row when both are DONE.
definitionOfDone: A daemon test fails on today's code: after qa_approve, and separately after qa_reject, the response does not hint an in-session claim (no nextAction moe.wait_for_task / claim_next_task). It signals the end of the session the same way request_replan does since task-55a5a9f9. Every other response field is unchanged.

docs/MCP_SERVER.md (### moe.qa_approve and ### moe.qa_reject) and any QA role-doc line that says to keep claiming in the same session describe the new hand-off. npm run lint passes if a role doc changed.
npm test and npx tsc --noEmit pass in packages/moe-daemon.

implementationPlan.description:
GREEN. In packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaApprove.ts and packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaReject.ts (lines at db7a8bfd; prototypes green/qaApprove.ts and green/qaReject.ts, full diff /mnt/d/moe-scratch/35723142-plan/proto.diff), with the Edit tool:
(1) Add `import { resolveWorkerRole } from '../util/workerRole.js';` right after the '../util/enforcement.js' import.
(2) Append to the tool's top-level description string: ' A verdict frees the QA seat: the reply carries sessionHandoff END_SESSION for it and no nextAction, so end the session; do not claim or wait inside it.'
(3) Immediately before the final `return {` (qaApprove.ts:280, after the #governors warning post; qaReject.ts:440, after the `message` const) add a block that is byte-identical in both files except the reason's first sentence: a comment naming it the twin of requestReplan.ts's sessionHandoff (task-55a5a9f9) and saying why (the verdict frees the QA seat; the wrapper pinned the session to its claim's attempt identity, so a claim/wait hint starts a second review whose verdict is refused ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED; a governor's verdict must not end the governance TUI; a seat whose pointer names another task is not ended), then:
const callerSeat = params.workerId && resolveWorkerRole(state, params.workerId) !== 'governor' ? params.workerId : undefined;
const seatWorker = handoffWorkerId || callerSeat;
const seatTaskId = seatWorker ? state.getWorker(seatWorker)?.currentTaskId : undefined;
const sessionHandoff = seatWorker && !seatTaskId ? { action: 'END_SESSION', taskId: task.id, workerId: seatWorker, reason: LEAD + TAIL } : undefined;
LEAD (qa_approve): 'Task approved. If the review surfaced a reusable pattern, record it with Serena write_memory (pattern-<area>), then end this session. '
LEAD (qa_reject): 'Rejection recorded on the task. Capture the failure pattern with Serena write_memory (gotcha-<area>), then end this session. '
TAIL (both, as string literals; escape the apostrophe in review's): 'Do not call moe.claim_next_task or moe.wait_for_task inside this session: the wrapper pinned it to this review's attempt identity, so a second review claimed here would have its verdict refused ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED. The wrapper claims the next REVIEW task in a fresh session. If this is an interactive TUI, return control to its operator so the CLI can exit normally.'
(4) Replace the reply's `nextAction: { tool: 'moe.wait_for_task', ... }` property (qaApprove.ts:298-305, qaReject.ts:458-465) with `...(sessionHandoff ? { sessionHandoff } : {}),`.
The block must run after touchWorker(handoffWorkerId, ...) (qaApprove.ts:265, qaReject.ts:408) so seatTaskId reads the idled pointer. Change nothing else: handoffWorkerId, touchWorker, gate and refusal order, message and every other reply field stay byte-identical (step 1's key and message pins check it). Do not touch requestReplan.ts or reportBlocked.ts: the reason text is per tool, not a shared helper (mem:decision-account-switch-end-session).
Error handling: the block does no I/O and cannot throw. getWorker on a missing record yields undefined (the hand-off is then still addressed, as in request_replan), and resolveWorkerRole returns null for an unknown seat (treated as non-governor). It adds no failure path after the DONE/WORKING write, and every existing refusal and the never-block chat try/catch stay unchanged. After this step the step-1 file passes 18/18 in the same snapshot with all three files overlaid.

The wrapper claims the next REVIEW task in a fresh session.

(d) qa_reject **Notes:** a new last bullet after '- **Closes the QA seat's attempt:** …' (:2394), exactly: - **Session hand-off — identical to `qa_approve`'s.** No `nextAction`; `sessionHandoff` `END_SESSION` is addressed, and omitted, by the same rule, the hard-cap park included.
